name: Vossmark Filtercap Daily Commuter
description:
A structured six-panel cap in charcoal ripstop polyblend with a matte-black stiffened brim. The fabric has a faint grid-weave texture that repels light rain and smog particulate passively. Embroidered on the left panel: a small orange Vossmark transit-line logo, worn soft from washing. Inside the crown, a thin activated-carbon filter layer sits removable and washable.

The rear strap is a standard plastic snap closure with a small notched channel cut to clear a standard neural port bump—low-profile, nothing fancy. Available in charcoal, slate, and rust-orange.
functionality: Passive particulate filtration via carbon-layer crown. Water-resistant outer shell. Neural-port notch at rear closure accommodates standard single-port hardware. Sweatband wicks moisture during active commutes.
what_it_says: You're practical, employed, and not interested in making a statement.
story_hooks: Vossmark only sells these at company commissaries — owning one outside the transit system raises quiet questions about how you got it.
A specific batch from late 2199 has a filter layer that doubles as a passive signal interceptor — someone added it on the factory floor.
Two witnesses at a Circuit-level labor dispute were wearing identical Vossmark caps — someone is coordinating, and the cap is the signal.

physical_description.visual_profile: A utilitarian six-panel cap with a structured crown and stiffened matte-black brim. Clean, functional silhouette that reads as working-class transit infrastructure—the kind of headwear you see on maintenance crews and daily commuters across the GLMZ. Modest and forgettable by design.
physical_description.fit: Snug crown with a relaxed, slightly oversized brim. Designed to sit comfortably over baseline human anatomy and clear common augmentation profiles, particularly rear neural port installations.
physical_description.primary_material: Charcoal ripstop polyblend—synthetic, durable, treated for passive water and particulate repulsion. Matte-black stiffened brim maintains shape through repeated compression.
physical_description.texture: Faint grid-weave texture visible up close; slightly rough to touch, almost woven appearance. The brim is smooth and rigid. Interior crown lined with a removable activated-carbon filter layer that feels slightly papery and fibrous.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray six panels with matte-black stiffened brim. Small orange Vossmark transit-line logo embroidered on left panel, softened from repeated washing.
physical_description.closures: Plastic snap rear closure on adjustable strap with a distinctive notched channel routed to accommodate neural port bumps without pressure points.
distinctive_features: Removable, washable activated-carbon filter layer in crown
Notched rear strap channel designed for neural port clearance
Faint grid-weave fabric texture for passive rain/smog resistance
Worn orange transit-line logo showing honest age and use
Matte finish eliminates glare in brightly lit urban corridors
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3–4 functional. Affordable, practical, mass-produced by a legitimate mid-tier transit goods manufacturer. Not luxury, not salvage.
physical_description.cultural_context: Signals daily commuter, transit worker, or working-class GLMZ resident. Wearing this says you navigate the public infrastructure regularly, you care about practical protection from urban air quality, and you trust established transit brands. No corporate prestige; no street edge.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and clean, but showing honest wear. The embroidered logo is softened from washing. The brim may show minor creases from storage. Filter layer shows light discoloration from use but is regularly replaced.
